metadata.question: Does the valley fog coverage in the Upper Arrow Lake area decrease from morning to afternoon on October 22, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need to detect fog/cloud coverage in Upper Arrow Lake area on October 22, 2018, comparing morning vs afternoon. - Location: Upper Arrow Lake in British Columbia, Canada - Date: October 22, 2018 - Need morning (e.g., 6-10 AM local time) vs afternoon (e.g., 1-5 PM local time) - Use Sentinel-2 for high resolution optical imagery 2. Masking strategy: Need to detect clouds/fog, not mask them. Can use cloud probability or cloud detection algorithms. 3. Logic: Calculate cloud coverage percentage for morning vs afternoon scenes. If afternoon coverage < morning coverage, answer A (Yes), else B (No). Approach: - Use Sentinel-2 with cloud probability band - Define Upper Arrow Lake area polygon - Filter for October 22, 2018, separate morning and afternoon - Calculate cloud coverage percentage for each time period - Compare and determine if afternoon has less coverage Potential issues: - No images available (C1) - No valid pixels after processing (C2) - Invalid calculations (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const upperArrowLake = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [-118.2, 50.2], [-117.8, 50.2], [-117.8, 50.5], [-118.2, 50.5], [-118.2, 50.2] ]); const date = '2018-10-22'; const morningStart = ee.Date(date).advance(6, 'hour'); // 6 AM const morningEnd = ee.Date(date).advance(10, 'hour'); // 10 AM const afternoonStart = ee.Date(date).advance(13, 'hour'); // 1 PM const afternoonEnd = ee.Date(date).advance(17, 'hour'); // 5 PM // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 with cloud probability const s2Col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_CLOUD_PROBABILITY') .filterBounds(upperArrowLake) .filterDate('2018-10-22', '2018-10-23'); // Check if collection is empty const collectionSize = s2Col.size().getInfo(); if (collectionSize === 0) { print("No Sentinel-2 images found for October 22, 2018"); print("C1"); return; } // Separate morning and afternoon images const morningImages = s2Col.filterDate(morningStart, morningEnd); const afternoonImages = s2Col.filterDate(afternoonStart, afternoonEnd); const morningCount = morningImages.size().getInfo(); const afternoonCount = afternoonImages.size().getInfo(); print(`Morning images: ${morningCount}, Afternoon images: ${afternoonCount}`); // Check if we have images for both periods if (morningCount === 0 || afternoonCount === 0) { print("Missing images for one or both time periods"); print("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate cloud coverage function calculateCloudCoverage(images) { const mosaic = images.mosaic(); const cloudProb = mosaic.select('probability'); // Count pixels with high cloud probability (>30%) const cloudMask = cloudProb.gt(30); const stats = cloudMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), null, true), geometry: upperArrowLake, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const cloudPixels = stats.get('probability_sum').getInfo(); const totalPixels = stats.get('probability_count').getInfo(); if (totalPixels === 0) { return {coverage: null, validPixels: 0}; } const coverage = (cloudPixels / totalPixels) * 100; return {coverage: coverage, validPixels: totalPixels}; } const morningStats = calculateCloudCoverage(morningImages); const afternoonStats = calculateCloudCoverage(afternoonImages); print(`Morning: ${morningStats.coverage?.toFixed(1)}% cloud (${morningStats.validPixels} px)`); print(`Afternoon: ${afternoonStats.coverage?.toFixed(1)}% cloud (${afternoonStats.validPixels} px)`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (morningStats.validPixels === 0 || afternoonStats.validPixels === 0) { print("No valid pixels in one or both time periods"); print("C2"); } else if (morningStats.coverage === null || afternoonStats.coverage === null || isNaN(morningStats.coverage) || isNaN(afternoonStats.coverage)) { print("Invalid cloud coverage calculation"); print("C3"); } else if (afternoonStats.coverage < morningStats.coverage) { print("Afternoon fog coverage is lower than morning"); print("A"); } else { print("Afternoon fog coverage is not lower than morning"); print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
